events.title: Windows 3.0 released
events.summary: [Microsoft] shipped Windows 3.0 on May 22, 1990 — the first widely successful version with protected mode, Program Manager, and Solitaire.
events.about: Windows 3.0 sold 10 million copies in two years and made GUIs standard on PCs — Visual Basic, Excel, and early Delphi apps targeted it. Protected mode finally used the 386 properly; developers wrote for one [API] instead of bare [DOS].

narrative.whyChosen: Windows 3.0 was the breakthrough that made [Microsoft] Windows a mass-market platform.
narrative.whyImportant: It shifted [PC] software from [DOS] text mode to graphical applications.
narrative.problemSolved: Earlier Windows versions were too limited; users and developers needed a credible [GUI] [OS].
